scenario: LSER.7.6.3: on a `ttl` schema every fact assertion absorbs as a sample. Drives the rule-side companion read `s.mean` on a `ttl` schema: each assert is a new fact, its activation reads the series PRE-SAMPLE (LSER.8.6.1), and the end-of-pump absorber adds it. Four asserts of 10, 20, 30, 40, one per pump: the first read is cold and does not log; the next three read the mean of what was absorbed before them -- 10.0, 15.0, 20.0. A runtime that absorbs nothing on `ttl` logs nothing, and one that absorbs only some logs other means. THE `where` READS A SERIES, SO IT IS RE-READ EVERY PUMP ([LTIM.2.4.1]) and each live fact fires once, on the pump its condition first holds ([LTIM.2.5.1]): the first fact, cold when it arrived, reads 10.0 at the second pump with the second fact, so `mean 10.0` logs twice.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sample scope ttl 1_d:
    dev: String
    level: Int

series Sample.level (by: dev):
    mean all_time

rule r:
    Sample s where s.mean is not null
->
    log info "mean {s.mean}"
